episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnick shares his journey from Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of lifestyle marketing, the role of AI in real estate, and strategies for staging and presenting luxury homes. Bill also emphasizes the value of personal branding and leveraging past experiences to build a successful real estate career.
